import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    df = inputs["readings"].copy()

    orig_cols = list(df.columns)

    if df.empty:
        quarantine_cols = orig_cols + ["batch_reject_pct"]
        return {
            "readings_clean": df.copy(),
            "readings_rejects": df.copy(),
            "readings_quarantine": pd.DataFrame(columns=quarantine_cols),
        }

    def is_bad(v):
        if pd.isna(v):
            return True
        try:
            return (v < 0) or (v > 1000)
        except TypeError:
            return True

    df["_bad"] = df["value"].apply(is_bad)

    grouped = (
        df.groupby("batch_id")["_bad"]
        .agg(bad_count="sum", total_rows="count")
    )
    grouped["reject_pct"] = grouped["bad_count"] * 100.0 / grouped["total_rows"]
    grouped["quarantined"] = (grouped["bad_count"] * 100) > (grouped["total_rows"] * 20)

    df = df.merge(
        grouped[["quarantined", "reject_pct"]],
        left_on="batch_id",
        right_index=True,
        how="left",
    )

    quarantine_mask = df["quarantined"]

    quarantine_df = df[quarantine_mask].copy()
    quarantine_df["batch_reject_pct"] = quarantine_df["reject_pct"].round(2)
    quarantine_df = quarantine_df[orig_cols + ["batch_reject_pct"]]

    remaining = df[~quarantine_mask]

    clean_df = remaining[~remaining["_bad"]][orig_cols].reset_index(drop=True)
    rejects_df = remaining[remaining["_bad"]][orig_cols].reset_index(drop=True)
    quarantine_df = quarantine_df.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "readings_clean": clean_df,
        "readings_rejects": rejects_df,
        "readings_quarantine": quarantine_df,
    }
